description:
Verify a signed receipt you already hold — FREE, no payment, no network call to us. Recomputes the canonical JSON digest and checks the Ed25519 signature against the published public key, so you can confirm a receipt's authenticity before you act on it.

VALUE: Free, because verifying a receipt you already paid for must never cost a second payment.

PRICE: FREE — no payment required.

Call it directly. No payment, no headers, no account.

body.description: The exact JSON body that was signed.

sha256.description: The sha256 hex digest of the canonical body.
